description: What changed in a law, or in the laws of a source or country: the articles whose wording changed, was inserted or repealed, newest first, with the day. A wording not yet in force is listed too. One law by its id gives all the changes held; a source or a jurisdiction goes five years back.

id.description: One law: an id from a result, or an identifier or citation.

jurisdiction.description: Or the laws of one jurisdiction ("ch").

lang.description: Two-letter language, for texts that exist in several.

offset.description: Lines to skip, for the next page.

since.description: Only changes from this day on, YYYY-MM-DD.

source.description: Or the laws of one source id from list_sources.

until.description: Only changes up to this day, YYYY-MM-DD.

name: get_changes
title: What changed in the law
